# IRoundsVaultOutput
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultOutput.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IRoundsVaultBase](./i-rounds-vault-base.md)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultOutput

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Marker interface for the Output flavor of `RoundsVaultBase`. Users deposit target vault
shares and receive ERC-1155 receipts. Once the keeper settles the round, the target vault's
underlying asset produced by the settlement redeem becomes the exchange asset that holders of
past-round receipts can redeem against.

The function surface is identical to `IRoundsVaultBase`; this interface exists so consumers
can statically distinguish Output-flavor vaults from Input-flavor vaults (`IRoundsVaultInput`).
Flavor-specific behavior lives in `RoundsVaultOutput`'s `_operate` and `_getFallbackExchangeRate`.
